title: Kingdom of Iceland
capsule: The Kingdom of Iceland was established by the Danish–Icelandic Act of Union on 1 December 1918, creating a sovereign state in personal union with Denmark under King Christian X. Iceland retained full internal self-governance while Denmark managed foreign affairs, and the arrangement was to be reviewed after twenty-five years. When Germany occupied Denmark in April 1940, British and then American forces occupied Iceland; the Althing declared the union dissolved in 1944, and a referendum on 20–23 June 1944 produced an overwhelming vote for a republic, formally proclaimed on 17 June 1944.
